lauds.name: Lauds
lauds.blurb: First light on pale limestone. Ink on stone, color pooling on the floor.

vespers.name: Vespers
vespers.blurb: Candles lit against plum shadow. The warmest of the dark hours.

compline.name: Compline
compline.blurb: Slate stone after the doors close. The default flavor.

matins.name: Matins
matins.blurb: The crypt before any light. Near-black stone, jewel-deep glass.

ruby.note: Copper ruby, the red of the great rose windows.

ember.note: Red-orange, a coal seen through thick glass.

amber.note: Deep silver stain, fired towards orange.

gilt.note: Pale silver stain, the yellow of halos.

cobalt.note: Cobalt blue, the signature of Gothic glazing.

indigo.note: Blue-violet, glass at the last light.

murrey.note: Murrey, the mulberry red-purple of glaziers.

rose.note: Soft rose, flesh tones and dawn.

rosace.name: Rosace
rosace.note: Ruby against cobalt, the rose window.

jesse.name: Jesse
jesse.note: Vine, gold and blood: the Jesse tree.

lancet.name: Lancet
lancet.note: A tall cool window, all blues.

aureole.name: Aureole
aureole.note: Halo light, gold falling to coal.

mono.name: Mono
mono.note: Pane, glass and lume of the current accent. The default.

harmonic.name: Harmonic
harmonic.note: The accent leaded with the pigments on either side of it.

pot-metal.name: Pot-metal
pot-metal.note: Glass colored through its whole body. Solid, opaque accent.

flashed.name: Flashed
flashed.note: A thin skin of color over clear glass. Translucent, glowing accent.

grisaille.name: Grisaille
grisaille.note: Monochrome glass with a colored border. Accent as a line only.
